d1.label: Decision 1 of 2
d1.title: The error mark
lede: Rule 11.15 draws the error mark, a circle holding an exclamation mark, in the text’s ink, and gives the error’s red to a 4 px Pillar Red bar at the left of the field and of the message. You approved the drawing on November 10. Its color comes to you by name because our red token was written for the mark and its bar, and Gate 2 confirms the tokens.

d1.b_text: The same mark drawn in Pillar Red, with the same bar.
d1.row_form: In the form, at actual size

d1.contrast_note: A mark that carries meaning needs 3 to 1 against its ground (Rule 05.5, and WCAG 2.2 success criterion 1.4.11). This board’s build works out each figure from the colors in our tokens.
d1.message: Enter an email address with an @, such as name@example.com.
rec: Option A. In Pillar Red the mark measures {b_band} to 1 on the Error Band and {b_np} to 1 on Newsprint, so a reader with low vision can lose it on either ground. In ink it measures {a_band} to 1 on the band, and the bar still gives the error the view’s red.
If you approve option A, the engineer rewords the red token’s description at Gate 2 so it names the bar alone. Option B changes one color in one drawing, and setting that color back undoes it.
d1.approve: Option A for the error mark, as Rule 11.15 draws it.

d2.label: Decision 2 of 2
d2.title: Tiles under the 48 px floor
lede: On November 8 you set 48 px as the smallest size for a topic or atlas symbol, with 24 px allowed only for the 41 that read there. A tile, the square, rounded square or circle that holds a drawing as an app icon or an avatar, draws its symbol at about two thirds of its own size. So a one-color tile from 48 px draws its symbol at 32 to 34 px, under that floor.
The tile sizes came from the October review, which read every drawing at 32 px before the floor was set. Rule 10.5 now names the small one-color tiles as the one exception:

d2.alone48_cap: The drawing alone at 48 px, the floor.
d2.other_cap: The smallest one-color tile at {px} px. Its drawing stands at about {inner} px.
rec: Keep the exception. Avatars and small app tiles show at 32 to 48 px, and on a tile the drawing sits on a solid ground of its own.
The other answer gives all {n_all} drawings one-color tiles from {sq}, {rd} and {ci} px, which keeps the 48 px floor with no exception and rules out small avatars.
d2.approve: Keep the one-color tile exception in Rule 10.5.

answered.title: What you answered this chat

lines: Round 3 ran three red teams side by side. One read brand, evidence and nonpartisanship, one read craft and accessibility, and one read plain language and ran a production test in which a simulated designer and developer each tried a real task with the guide.
An item still under 4 after the fix pass gets a short second pass on that item alone when the fix is craft or wording, and only an item that needs your call comes to this board.
The chapters page asks the host for its download permission, so its tokens.css button saves the file for anyone viewing it.
Board B is three pages: the chapters page at its address as version 5, this decisions board and the reader check on its own private page.
Once you have sent the new reader check link, the first reader check page is deleted after you confirm.
Chapter 11’s loop stepper runs our atlas’s loop R1, in which wealth and political influence reinforce each other.

The 16 px Pause and Filter files get 5 px bars and a 5 px spout, so each opening keeps a whole open pixel on 1x screens, and they come to you beside the approved files at stage C.

decision_1.rule_11_15_why: Each state has a shape and a word, so none rests on color. The error mark draws in ink because Pillar Red measures 2.64 to 1 on the Error Band and 2.96 on Newsprint, under the 3 to 1 a mark needs; in ink it measures 11.89 to 1, and the red bar carries the error’s claim on the view’s red. Verdigris measures 3.37 to 1 on Newsprint.

decision_2.rule_10_5_quote: A one-color tile may go smaller, from 48 px square and 52 px rounded or round, which holds its drawing at 32 to 34 px. This is the one place a drawing off the list of 41 goes under Rule 10.4’s 48 px floor, and it is open only to the 94 drawings that reviewers could still name at 32 px. The other 30 take one-color tiles from 72, 76 and 80 px, which hold them at 48 px or more.

Rule 05.3’s corrective plate drew the error as a white cross in a red disc, the sign for Close, where you had approved a circle holding an exclamation mark.

calls.rule_09_1_quote: The 48 px row runs near the top of a page that introduces the four pillars or gathers one pillar’s work, and the 24 px row, the compact row, runs in the header of a single piece that serves one pillar. A social card and a kicker carry no row.
